lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The most wanted man on the dark web was caught by a Google search.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: An IRS agent looked for the oldest posts about Silk Road, and found a user called altoid.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Later, altoid had asked for coding help, and left his email: rossulbricht at gmail dot com.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Then border agents found nine fake IDs, all with his face, all addressed to his apartment.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: When agents asked about it, he said that, hypothetically, anyone could buy them on Silk Road.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The full story is on Unfiled Films.
